changelog:
• New Brand Identity: Updated app icon and visual branding.
• Added VPN Hotspot Sharing: Share your secure connection with other devices via LAN IP.
• Professional Crash Reporter: Built-in diagnostic tool to capture and share technical logs.
• Advanced UI Animations: Redesigned Toast notifications.
• Local HTTP Proxy Support: Built-in proxy server for seamless relay to SOCKS5 core.
• Android 8 Stability Fix: Resolved critical VPN service crashes on older Android versions.
• Optimized Split Tunneling: New 'Include Mode' (Default Bypass) for better control.
• Improved Traffic Monitoring: Real-time precision and flickering fixes.
• Enhanced Protocol Stability: Isolated settings storage for each protocol.
• Unified Edge-to-Edge UI: Consistent headers and professional layout across all screens.
